statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I47.1
The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient has symptomatic complaints of giddiness
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary
